race.description: Real Punters Play Here Tabtouch Hcp (C3)
race.comment: ARTICOLE (2) resumes as the horse to beat after ending last campaign with a soft-track fourth at Belmont Park in NMW1Y company, beaten just under two lengths, after a narrow Class 3 placing the run prior. His 1200m profile is strong and a Lark Hill trial gives him a suitable platform. HOYA DESTROYER (3) has also been away, but he brings consistent Class 3 form, two recent trials and Steven Parnham back aboard, so he is the clear danger if ready. SUPERB VINTAGE (11) had little room late when sixth at Belmont Park and is already a three-time winner around this trip, which makes her a genuine winning threat second-up. SHOWLAS (5) was close up first-up at Ascot and coming back in trip from a good draw, she can feature. BONDITRAM (6) can be in this for a long way as he steps out in distance now.
